svg.title: PriVA installation: storage roots, configurable names and resource preparation
svg.desc: Default destinations for a fresh installation. Set existing cache_root and tmp_dir paths, assembly and VEP major. The checkout holds bundled snapshots, the existing Mamba root holds separate environments, cache_root holds downloaded and derived resources, and tmp_dir holds scratch work. Blue path names and brace tokens are selected by YAML. D means automatic download, B build, M manual publisher files, R repository bundle, E installed-package export. Supplied originals are preserved; explicit reference/mapping paths and completed legacy software retain their selected locations. Managed copies and converted outputs use the configured cache folders. The diagram does not establish scientific-profile qualification.
svg.text: Four storage roots · default names shown · resources prepared as needed
Before main_install: choose existing paths and the annotation profile
Existing writable absolute directories; installation stops if either is invalid.
hg19 / GRCh37 or hg38 / GRCh38 (default hg19)
Blue = YAML-controlled path/name/token. D Download B Build M Manual input R Bundled E Export
Persistent managed resource destinations. The six blue top-level names can be changed through cache_folders.
Official plugins matching the VEP release.
Shared data used by VEP plugins.
Full prescores are external, downloaded here.
VEP / gnomAD / domain / DAS / PM1 builds.
Supplied originals → index or TSV adapter.
pext if enabled; MaveDB omitted for GRCh37.
Pinned upstream source + shared CADD assets.
SNV/indel tables and paired tabix indexes.
Original raw model and PHRED conversion.
A supplied ref_genome keeps its path.
Managed fallback if a bundle is unavailable.
Existing bundled snapshots remain in checkout.
External raw workspace if a mapping is absent.
Completed small tables go into checkout/data.
Nextflow driver + JRE; this checkout only.
Bundled snapshots are reused in place; these destinations do not require duplicate copies.
Supplied originals are preserved; managed copies/conversions use these folders. Reference/mapping overrides stay selected.
Source and bundled data belong to the Git checkout; genome-wide downloaded caches do not.
Bundled snapshots; reused in the checkout.
GRCh38 / VEP116; distinct pinned FTP source.
Protein regions, GoF and mechanism snapshots.
An explicit nm_to_enst_tsv stays selected. Other assembly/release pairs need a compatible supplied mapping.
ClinVar gene stats reuse the bundle; an eligible ≥3-month-newer ClinVar source triggers managed regeneration.
Discovered from the existing environment manager; no extra storage-root YAML key.
Wrappers, prefix routes, receipts and profiles.
Scoring: priva_acmg → original CADD Python child process → priva_acmg. No manual activation switch.
The parent environment stays intact on success or failure; failures propagate. Legacy owned prefixes are reused.
Temporary tool work and cache-building scratch; no family input is needed to install.
Some resumable cache staging stays beside
its destination rather than under tmp_dir.
Choose input_vcf, ped_file and output_dir separately when preparing an analysis run.
{vep} = vep_installed_version (116); {ucsc} = hg19 or hg38; {GRCh} = GRCh37 or GRCh38.
{ucsc}/{GRCh} are normalized from assembly; {assembly} keeps its configured spelling (default hg19).
Installation prepares resources. A changed annotation/scoring profile still requires its separate scientific qualification.
